diffs.diff: chip ID register 0xe: part 22544, datasheet reading 4184
diffs.evidence: The Vishay VCNL4200 datasheet gives register 0x0E as ID_L (data byte low) '58H for MP version sample, device ID LSB byte' and ID_H (data byte high) 10H, read low byte first, and the Adafruit library for this exact board checks 'if (device_id != 0x1058) { // Expected device ID for VCNL4200', so the logical ID is 0x1058 = 4184 (the second reading); the sim register value 22544 = 0x5810 in the model is the same ID in wire byte order, because the simulator 16-bit registers (src/sim/devices.ts setReg) send the high byte of the stored value first, so the sim sends 0x58 then 0x10, the driver builds d[0] | d[1]<<8 = 0x1058 and checks ID_L == 0x58, SKILL.md documents ID = 0x1058, and check.ts PASSes.
